lines.zh: 三根镰刀爪垂在胸前晃
lines.en: My three sickle claws swing before my chest

lines.zh: 我用后腿走路，脚掌很宽
lines.en: I walk on wide hind feet
My long neck reaches into the canopy
My claws sweep branches aside
My tail levels out to keep balance

lines.zh: 我沿着林间空地慢慢挪
lines.en: I shuffle along the forest clearing
I check the ground before each step
The tender leaves up high suit me
Sunlight warms my back

lines.zh: 我停下来啃了两口灌木
lines.en: I stop to nibble a bush
A ten-meter shadow follows me

lines.zh: 我把爪子收拢，免得挂着树
lines.en: I fold my claws so they don't snag trees
The grass is softer across the river

lines.zh: 我迈着不紧不慢的步子
lines.en: I keep an unhurried pace

lines.zh: 我站着咀嚼，嘴角挂着叶渣
lines.en: I chew standing still, leaf bits at my lips
I rub my claws against each other
Wind passes; I narrow my eyes
A carnivore calls in the distance
I lift my head and listen
Tree shadows move across my back

lines.zh: 我换了条腿站着，慢慢嚼叶
lines.en: I shift to my other leg and keep chewing leaves
This fern is a bit tough
No rush; grass doesn't run

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出低低的咕声
lines.en: A low coo rises in my throat

lines.zh: 阳光从冠层缝隙落下来
lines.en: Sunlight falls through gaps in the canopy

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脖子上的皮褶
lines.en: I shake the skin folds on my neck
A small bug lands on my claw
I let out a heavy breath
You hold still; so do I

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子弯成弓
lines.en: I bend my neck down to look at you

lines.zh: 我的爪尖离你只有一步
lines.en: My claw tips are one step from you
I don't eat meat; relax

lines.zh: 你身上这股味儿我没闻过
lines.en: I've never smelled your kind before

lines.zh: 你把双手张开，我退了半步
lines.en: You spread your hands; I step back half a pace

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳有点快
lines.en: I hear your heart going a bit fast
Want to touch me? Slowly

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你的影子上面
lines.en: My eyes rest above your shadow

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子让我好奇
lines.en: The way you look up makes me curious
I stretch my neck taller than you
Don't stand under my claws

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西会反光
lines.en: That thing in your hand catches light
I'm not afraid, just wary
I blink slowly in front of you
If you back off, I won't follow

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，像在琢磨你
lines.en: I tilt my head as if working you out

lines.zh: 你没武器，那我就不抬爪
lines.en: You carry no weapon, so my claws stay down
I hiss and back away
My claws pull back to my chest

lines.zh: 我抬起伤腿，又慢慢放下
lines.en: I lift the hurt leg, then set it down slowly
I lower my head to shield my neck

lines.zh: 这一下打得我歪了身子
lines.en: That blow tips my body

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音变尖了
lines.en: My throat voice sharpens
I retreat behind a tree, panting
Blood seeps between my scales

lines.zh: 我把爪子举起来，护在身前
lines.en: I raise my claws in front of myself
The pain makes my tail slap the ground
Are those tender leaves? Give them here
I smell sweet berries

lines.zh: 你把枝条举高，我够到了
lines.en: You raise the branch and I reach it
I lower my head and wait
This bite takes branch and leaf
I chew loudly, well satisfied
Any more? I can eat more

lines.zh: 你的手掌摊开，我就靠近
lines.en: Your open palm brings me closer
Don't take it away; I've had one bite
My tongue sweeps the corner of my mouth
Your shoulder hits my leg
The bump tips my body sideways

lines.zh: 我太宽了，这条路不够走
lines.en: I'm too wide for this path

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我的爪子差点划到你
lines.en: We brush past; my claws nearly catch you
Don't push me from behind
I turn and my tail hits you

lines.zh: 树被我撞得叶子落了一地
lines.en: I knock leaves off the tree

lines.zh: 你我挤在一处，都退了一步
lines.en: We crowd together and both step back
I lift a claw and make way

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，只是笨重
lines.en: That wasn't an attack, just bulk

lines.zh: 林子里传来回应的低鸣
lines.en: A low answer comes from the woods

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，爪子几乎碰到
lines.en: We stand side by side, claws almost touching

lines.zh: 我绕着她走，脖子微微低下
lines.en: I circle her with my neck dipped
I bring the tenderest branch
She accepts and chews slowly

lines.zh: 我们的影子在草地上叠在一起
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the grass

lines.zh: 我用喙似的嘴碰了碰她的颈
lines.en: I touch her neck with my beak-like snout

lines.zh: 她在树根下刨了个浅窝
lines.en: She scrapes a shallow nest by the roots

lines.zh: 以后这片林子我们共用
lines.en: We'll share this wood from now on

lines.zh: 我们同时抬头，看向同一棵高树
lines.en: We lift our heads to the same tall tree

lines.zh: 我用爪子夹起来，很小心
lines.en: I pinch it carefully between my claws
It's so small I can't grip it
I raise it before my eyes
It's hard when I bite it

lines.zh: 我放在地上，用爪子拨了拨
lines.en: I set it down and nudge it
It rolls; I chase it two steps
I hold it in my mouth so it won't drop
This color looks like leaves
I'll put it by my nest
Not grass, but I'll keep it

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我立刻看过去
lines.en: You raise a weapon and my head snaps over

lines.zh: 我不吃肉，可我的爪子很重
lines.en: I eat no meat, but my claws are heavy

lines.zh: 你踩断的那根树枝暴露了你
lines.en: The branch you snapped gave you away
I raise a claw as a warning

lines.zh: 别在我吃东西时靠这么近
lines.en: Don't come this close while I'm eating

lines.zh: 我发出像风箱一样的声音
lines.en: I make a sound like a bellows
Back off and I'll lower my claws

lines.zh: 我判断了一下你的距离
lines.en: I measure the distance to you

lines.zh: 我的喉咙鼓起来，要吼了
lines.en: My throat swells; a roar is coming
You struck first; I noticed

lines.zh: 这么大的东西也会发怒
lines.en: Even something this size can get angry
My sickle claws spread

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我警觉
lines.en: The iron smell on you puts me on guard
I turn side-on and point my claws forward
I don't want this fight, but I won't flee

lines.zh: 现在我看着你，只看着你
lines.en: Now my eyes are on you and nothing else

lines.zh: 我跟着你转，爪子始终朝前
lines.en: I pivot with you, claws always forward

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就扬起脖子
lines.en: Each time you close in, my neck goes up
I don't charge; you come first

lines.zh: 我的重量就是我的武器
lines.en: My weight is the weapon

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面，我也侧过去
lines.en: You circle sideways; so do I

lines.zh: 我一下一下地呼吸，很沉
lines.en: My breathing comes slow and heavy
I dare not turn my back
Holding my claws up tires them
You retreat and I stop a step
I give a call, thick and low

lines.zh: 你的动作我看得很清楚
lines.en: I see your movements clearly
I dislike being circled

lines.zh: 我把两只脚扎稳，才抬爪子
lines.en: I plant both feet before I lift a claw

lines.zh: 每一次你抬手，我都绷紧
lines.en: Every time you lift a hand, I tense
That fern patch won't stop me

lines.zh: 我们僵在这儿，谁也不让
lines.en: We hold here, neither giving way
My tail lowers, ready to swing
Go if you want; I won't chase

lines.zh: 镰刀爪横扫，划过你的护甲
lines.en: My sickle claw sweeps across your armor
I slam down and the grass flattens

lines.zh: 这一爪是直的，不是吓唬
lines.en: This claw is straight, not a bluff

lines.zh: 你躲开了，我的爪插进土里
lines.en: You dodge; my claw stabs the dirt
I throw my whole body at you
My neck whips and the claws follow
Your shield dents a little
I lift a foreleg and rake again
I hit a tree and splinters fly
I catch your sleeve and tear it

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也顿住了
lines.en: Even I stall after that swing
You roll away along the ground

lines.zh: 我的爪尖划出一道白痕
lines.en: My claw leaves a white streak
I catch my breath and come again

lines.zh: 别以为我是吃草的就好惹
lines.en: Don't think a plant-eater is easy
I step back half a pace, claws retracted

lines.zh: 树冠下，一片影子站了起来
lines.en: Under the canopy, a shadow stands up

lines.zh: 我的爪子先在蕨叶间露出
lines.en: My claws show first between the ferns

lines.zh: 一根长脖子从树后探出来
lines.en: A long neck comes around a tree
I set down and the ground gives a soft thud
The woods suddenly go quiet
I raise a claw to the high branches
One foot snaps a dead branch

lines.zh: 十米高的身体慢慢转过来
lines.en: A ten-meter body slowly turns
I walk from sunlight into shade
I give a long yawn

lines.zh: 叶子上还留着我的爪痕
lines.en: My claw marks stay on the leaves
I've come here for tender shoots
My breathing arrives before I do

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气，这里草嫩
lines.en: I sniff; the grass here is good

lines.zh: 我低下头，让你的身影入眼
lines.en: I lower my head and take in your shape
My sickle claws rest against my chest
I walk slowly into the clearing

lines.zh: 我停下，看着这边的动静
lines.en: I stop and watch what moves here

lines.zh: 我的一片鳞甲在阳光下亮起
lines.en: One of my scales catches the sun
I arrive quietly, but I'm not small

lines.zh: 火苗爬上我的鳞片，我往湿地跑
lines.en: Flames climb my scales; I run for wet ground

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，腿先着地
lines.en: I fall from height and land on my legs

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我猛地抬头
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I jerk my head up

lines.zh: 爆风掀翻我，四周全是土
lines.en: The blast flips me; dirt everywhere

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我的肩甲缝里
lines.en: An arrow lodges in a seam of my shoulder plates
That cold force turns inside my bones

lines.zh: 我整天没吃到叶子，腿发软
lines.en: No leaves all day; my legs feel weak

lines.zh: 雷劈在我的脖子上，眼前一白
lines.en: Lightning hits my neck; everything goes white

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我抓不到任何东西
lines.en: No ground beneath me; my claws catch nothing
